_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Information Security (IS) Plan of Action & Milestones (POA&M)
summary: The IS Posture POA&M provides information on the current state of the network security infrastructure and information needed to understand and improve the security posture.
use_relationship:
The IS Posture POA&M provides information on the current state of the network security infrastructure. It provides information needed to understand and improve the security posture.
This data item description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
DoDI 8510.1 Risk Management Framework (RMF) for DoD Information Technology (IT) is available at: http://www.esd.whs.mil/Directives/issuances/dodi/

references.label: DoDI 8510.1 Risk Management Framework (RMF) for DoD Information Technology (IT) is available at

distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The IS Posture POA&M shall follow the enterprise Mission Assurance Support System (eMASS) System Level Microsoft Excel format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The IS Posture POA&M shall include a network POA&M that contains the following:

children.title: Department of Defense (DoD) Information Technology (IT) registration number
Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Project Identification
Weakness.
children.content: Weaknesses shall be specified consecutively and numerically. This section shall include the following:

children.title: Specific Security Weakness Identified via DoD tools or Information Assurance Control (IAC) Tests.
Security Actions and Administrative Actions
children.content: e.g., finish Systems Requirements Review (SRR) tests, and register system in Department of Defense Information Technology Portfolio Registration-Department of the Navy (DITPR-DON))

children.title: If not applicable, then Not Applicable (NA) shall be included
The severity Category (CAT).
children.content: The severity CAT is the residual risk and shall be specified as CAT I, II, III. If not applicable, this shall be the original Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA) Severity and identified as "raw".

children.title: Information Assurance Control (IAC) and Impact Code.
children.content: This section shall include the following:

children.title: Information Assurance (IA) control assigned to the finding
Impact code assigned to the IA control.
children.content: Note that the impact code shall not change.

children.title: POC.
children.content: Identify Office/Organization responsible for resolving the security weakness.

children.title: Include NA for CAT III weaknesses
Date when the weakness is scheduled to be resolved.
children.content: Status column shall identify completion date updates (e.g., Not Okay = TBD, FY10, 3Q, etc)

children.title: If risks are accepted by Office of the Designating Authority (ODAA), then NA shall be specified.
Identify specific requirements to correct weaknesses
Column 8 (Milestone change) shall identify changes to any milestones
If risks are accepted by ODAA, then NA shall be specified.
Updates to the milestones/Completion date shall be included
If risks are accepted by ODAA, then NA shall be specified.
This shall identify the source of the weakness
children.content: (i.e., Security Test Implementation Guide (STIG), Security Checklists, Retina, gold disk, etc.)

children.title: This shall identify the weakness type.
Include weakness identification
children.content: (i.e., STIG ID, Vulnerability Management System Identification (VMS ID), Audit ID, etc.).

children.title: Shall specify status as "ongoing", "completed, or "risk accepted", "not valid - pending", "TBD", etc.
Adequate explanation in the comments column shall be included.
children.content: Completion date shall be included if status is "completed".

children.title: "Risk accepted" status shall be identified only after the risk is accepted by the ODAA.
Date of acceptance shall be specified.
Necessary information, justification and mitigation shall be included.
This shall also contain justification for NA IA controls.
